run_glm_image_before_denoising_stage: run the GlmImageBeforeDenoisingStage pipeline to generate prior tokens and encode prompts for text-to-image diffusion
generate_prior_tokens: generate prior image tokens using the AR vision-language encoder from a text prompt with shape specification
encode_prompt: encode a text prompt into glyph embeddings using the frozen text encoder with optional classifier-free guidance
retrieve_timesteps: retrieve diffusion scheduler timesteps with support for custom timestep or sigma schedules
calculate_shift: calculate the shift parameter for diffusion timestep scheduling based on image sequence length
